name: Website Hosting & Maintenance
tagline: Monthly website care — updates, backups, monitoring, and security — so your site stays fast, secure, and online.

hero.headline: Keep Your Website Secure and Performing at Its Best
hero.subhead: Ongoing hosting setup, monitoring, backups, and content updates so your website never becomes an afterthought.

description: A website isn't a one-time project — it's a living asset that needs regular care. I handle domain and hosting setup, monthly content updates, automated backups, uptime monitoring, and security checks so problems get caught before they become emergencies. Whether I built your site or not, I can take over ongoing care for it.
problems: Your website has gone stale — no one's updating content, checking uptime, or watching for issues
You're not sure if your site is backed up, secure, or even monitored
Small content changes (a new price, a new photo) shouldn't need a developer, but you don't want to touch the code yourself
You built your site elsewhere and need someone to maintain it
deliverables: Plugin and dependency updates, plus broken-link checks
features: Performance optimization for page speed and Core Web Vitals
Works on sites I built or existing sites on Next.js, WordPress, Webflow, or Wix
Emergency same-day response available as an add-on
SEO monitoring add-on for ongoing ranking checks
Month-to-month — cancel anytime with 30 days notice

process.detail: Initial review of hosting, backups, security, and performance — especially for sites I didn't build.
Hosting and domain configuration, backup automation, and monitoring put in place.
Content updates, plugin updates, and security scans on a regular cadence.
24/7 uptime monitoring with alerts the moment something goes down.
A monthly report summarizing changes, backups, and performance.

faqs.question: What counts as a 'content update'?
faqs.answer: Changing text, swapping an image, updating a price, adding a phone number, changing business hours — any edit that doesn't require building a new page or section.

faqs.question: What happens if my site goes down?
faqs.answer: Uptime monitoring alerts me immediately. I investigate and fix the issue within the agreed response time — same-day with the Emergency Support add-on.

faqs.question: Do you maintain sites you didn't build?
faqs.answer: Yes, for sites built on Next.js, WordPress, Webflow, or Wix. I'll do an initial audit first to assess the site's condition.

faqs.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes — this is a month-to-month service. Cancel anytime with 30 days notice.
